notes.title: 🐞 Bug Fixes – The Darkblade Patch 2025-07-25
notes.content: [p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]Today’s patch focuses on fixing a major crash and improving one of the upgrade UX issues:[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fix: Force Close with Indonesian Language[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when playing with [b]Bahasa Indonesia[/b] selected[/p][/*][*][p]The game should now run [b]smoothly[/b] in Indonesian — no more sudden force closes during gameplay or menus[/p][/*][*][p]Terima kasih for your patience![/p][/*][/list][p]✨ [b]Upgrade Menu Closing Enhancement[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the behavior when [b]closing the Core Upgrade UI/Enhancement[/b][/p][/*][*][p]No more awkward transitions or UI glitches after upgrading — it now feels smoother and more responsive[/p][/*][/list][p]Im continuing to polish the game and squash bugs — thanks to everyone reporting issues and helping me make [i]The Darkblade[/i] a better experience.[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Controller Update – D-Pad Movement Support + Menu Fix
notes.content:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve got a small but meaningful update for all the controller players out there![/p][p]✅ [b]New: D-Pad Support for Movement[/b]
You can now use the [b]D-Pad[/b] to move your character — not just the analog stick![/p][list][*][p]Ideal for precision movement in tight spaces[/p][/*][*][p]Great for those who prefer classic directional input[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fix: Load Game Dialog Not Closing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Load Game dialog[/b] wouldn’t close after selecting a save file from the main menu (when using controller)[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again to everyone who reported these issues and shared suggestions — your feedback directly improves [i]The Darkblade[/i] every step of the way.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🐞 Bug Fixes – The Darkblade Patch 2025-06-20
notes.content: [p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]Here’s a quick patch focused on cleaning up some lingering issues — thanks to all the sharp-eyed players who pointed them out![/p][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🗣️ Fixed awkward phrasing [b]“Wise, Indeed...” [/b]into [b] “Wise?”[/b] in the final dialogue with the samurai[/p][/*][*][p]🌲 Corrected duplicate text [b]“Oak ForestForest”[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🌍 Fixed [b]glitchy ground[/b] in Oak Forest area[/p][/*][*][p]🧙‍♀️ Adjusted dialogue between [b]Eleonore and Joanna[/b] in Night City — they now correctly refer to [b]L as "he"[/b] instead of "you"[/p][/*][*][p]💎 Fixed not working [b]Core Upgrades [/b][/p][/*][/list][p]These fixes are all part of making [i]The Darkblade[/i] world feel more polished and immersive.[/p][p]Got something odd happening in your playthrough? Let us know! And as always, [b]wishlist the full game[/b] and help spread the word![/p]

notes.title: 🖥️ Update – Fullscreen Now Works with Any Resolution
notes.content:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve rolled out a small but important update to improve fullscreen support:[/p][p]✅ [b]Fullscreen Now Works with Any Resolution[/b]
You can now switch to fullscreen using [b]any resolution[/b] available in the settings — no restrictions.[/p][p]❗[b]Note:[/b] If your selected resolution doesn’t match your monitor’s aspect ratio, the game will display with [b]black bars[/b] to maintain proper scaling and avoid distortion. This ensures the pixel art and gameplay look crisp and consistent across all setups.[/p][p]Thanks as always for your feedback — keep it coming! And if you haven’t already, [b]wishlist The Darkblade[/b] on Steam and help spread the word![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update – New Setting: HUD Distance Adjustment
notes.content:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve added a small but handy new setting to give you more control over your UI experience:[/p][p]✅ [b]New: HUD Distance Setting[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/41ab23ef2f79ede447307f47deaeb598aeccc27d.png"][/img]
Now you can [b]adjust how close or far the HUD appears from screen edges[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Prefer a tighter UI for fast reflexes? Pull it in.[/p][/*][*][p]Want breathing room on an ultrawide setup? Space it out.[/p][/*][*][p]Works great alongside the [b]UI Scale[/b] setting![/p][/*][/list][p]This should help players fine-tune their experience based on screen size, personal comfort, or aesthetic preference.[/p][p]🧠 Little changes like this go a long way — and they’re only possible thanks to your feedback.[/p][p]As always, [b]wishlist The Darkblade[/b] if you haven’t already and let us know what settings or tweaks you’d love next![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🩸 Update – Enemy Health Bars Are Here!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Gamers,[/p][p]Back with another quality-of-life update — this time focused on clarity in combat.[/p][p]✅ [b]Health Bars for Enemies[/b]
You’ll now see health indicators for:[/p][list][*][p]👹 [b]Regular Enemies[/b] – Know how much more pain they can take[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/89d7f4beb5fb8f97b9e6706595c33c02fef00d69.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]🐉 [b]Boss Enemies[/b] – Track your progress through those intense fights[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/addb007dd73fb7d4c6416238b7f0a1dba329013f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're planning your next dodge or deciding when to go all-in, this makes fights more readable, strategic, and satisfying.[/p][p]📣 This is part of our ongoing goal to improve the experience without removing the challenge.
Let us know what you think — and what you'd like to see next![/p][p]As always, [b]wishlist The Darkblade[/b] on Steam if you haven’t already and join the growing community![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🩸 Major Update – Health Points Added in Casual Mode!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Gamers,[/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and one thing came through loud and clear:[/p][quote][p][i]“Casual Mode is still brutally hard.”[/i][/p][/quote][p]📊 Based on feedback from over 80% of players, we’re making a [b]major update[/b] to improve the experience:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ [b]Health Points Added to Casual Mode[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/14ec8e53e39135556f1f8ebaf0c545094105f8f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Casual Mode now features its own [b]HP system[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]You can take multiple hits without dying instantly[/p][/*][*][p]Makes the game more forgiving and exploration-friendly[/p][/*][*][p]Great for players who want to focus on the story and atmosphere[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]❗Note: Now [b]you will NOT receive any defense % buffs[/b].[/p][/quote][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🖥️ [b]New: UI Scale Settings[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/ab39fef9db86e58dcb35ab4be6a04dd4b137e25e.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now adjust the [b]UI size[/b] from the settings menu![/p][list][*][p]Useful for different screen sizes or personal preference[/p][/*][*][p]Especially helpful on large displays[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 Keep the Feedback Coming!
This game is built with your input. We're committed to making The Darkblade challenging but fair — and fun for everyone.[/p][p]If you haven’t already, [b]wishlist the game on Steam[/b] and help spread the word![/p]

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.content:
Hey Gamers,

We’ve updated The Darkblade with some exciting new features!

🎮 Full Controller Support
The Darkblade now fully supports gamepads! Especially Xbox Controller, you can now slash, roll, and dodge enemies comfortably from your couch.

🧭 Demo Content Update
The demo just got a little change:

- The whole content update into mid-game(ish)
- Updated dialogue scenes

Hidden lore for those who seek it
(Yes, you lore skippers still get the summary and skip button 😉)

💬 Let Us Know What You Think
Your feedback has been incredible so far. Keep it coming 🔥.

Thanks for playing and supporting The Darkblade. If you haven’t already, wishlist the full game on Steam to follow L's journey.
